mostWorthwhile.text: Building the deeper skin was most worthwhile because it explained how living cells in the outer layer get supplies even though that layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two named slots was clear but a little repetitive; there was not much to figure out once the parts were made.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from underneath.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named slots made the connections understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: the skin's different jobs and the way its layers connect to the body gave me something new to think about, even if some fittings were predictable.
